item.text: The entity model is in `openlibrary/core/wikidata.py`, and the author infobox currently uses Wikidata only for its description. I’m adding tolerant parsing for Wikidata’s statement and sitelink shapes, then rendering the resulting profile records in the infobox and supplying the three icon assets the records reference.

The model and infobox changes are in place, including the expected icon paths. I’m reviewing the diff for template syntax and edge cases now, then I’ll run the repository’s existing Wikidata test module.

item.text:
Implemented structured Wikidata profiles and displayed them in the author infobox. Wikipedia links use the requested language with English fallback; Google Scholar entries are generated for each valid P1960 identifier.

Verification: `pytest -q openlibrary/tests/core/test_wikidata.py` passed (7 tests), and `git diff --check` passed. The existing test module does not cover the new profile methods.
